map.NT-proBNP(心衰)截断值评估器 使用指南: NT-proBNP (Heart Failure) Cutoff Evaluator User Guide
map.根据ESC/ACC年龄分层截断值，评估NT-proBNP对急性心衰的诊断价值及预: Uses ESC/ACC age-stratified cutoffs to assess the diagnostic value of NT-proBNP for acute heart failure and the prognostic risk
map.年龄分层截断值：NT-proBNP 排除心衰阈值随年龄升（一般 <50 岁 <1: Age-stratified cutoffs: the NT-proBNP heart failure exclusion threshold rises with age (generally under 125 pg/ml below 50, under 300 for 50-75, under 450 above 75, varying slightly by guideline), used to exclude acute heart failure.
map.灰区解读：介于排除与确诊截断之间提示非心源性或轻度心衰/房颤/高龄/肾损，需结合: Gray zone reading: between the exclusion and diagnostic cutoffs it suggests non-cardiac causes or mild heart failure / atrial fibrillation / advanced age / renal impairment, and must be judged with the clinical picture and ultrasound.
map.诊断与随访：值越高心衰可能性越大；治疗后下降提示容量与负荷改善，动态变化比单次更: Diagnosis and follow-up: the higher the value the greater the likelihood of heart failure; a drop after treatment suggests improved volume and load, and the trend matters more than a single value.
map.：输入：女、78 岁、NT-proBNP 520 pg/ml、伴气促、无肾衰。工: Input: female, 78 years old, NT-proBNP 520 pg/ml, with breathlessness and no renal failure. Tool output: the age cutoff (over 75) is 450, the result is above the exclusion value, and it notes heart failure cannot be excluded (upper gray zone), recommending combination with ultrasound EF and the clinical picture and attention to the effect of kidney function. Note: BNP is affected by age, kidney function and obesity.
map.心衰NYHA分级与六分钟步行评估器: Heart Failure NYHA Grading and Six-Minute Walk Evaluator
map.NT-proBNP 随年龄升高、肾功下降也升、肥胖者偏低，故指南按年龄设排除阈值: NT-proBNP rises with age and also rises when kidney function declines, while being lower in people with obesity, so the guidelines set age-based exclusion thresholds (such as <50 / <300 / <450 pg/ml) to raise sensitivity; being above the cutoff only prompts further investigation and is not a diagnosis.
map.值在灰区说明什么？: What does a value in the gray zone mean?
map.灰区（排除与确诊之间）常见于非心因气促、房颤、肺部感染、肾损或轻度心衰，不能单凭: The gray zone between exclusion and diagnosis is common with non-cardiac dyspnea, atrial fibrillation, pulmonary infection, renal impairment or mild heart failure; a single number cannot decide it, and symptoms, chest X-ray, ultrasound and trend must be combined.
map.治疗后下降代表好转吗？: Does a drop after treatment mean improvement?
map.多数急性心衰有效利尿/扩管后 NT-proBNP 下降提示容量与心室负荷改善，下: In most acute heart failure cases an effective diuretic or vasodilator leads to a drop in NT-proBNP, indicating improved volume and ventricular load, and the size of the drop correlates with prognosis; but a single value is confounded by many factors, so dynamic follow-up is more valuable.
